source.documented_semantics: Historical market-cap data for all stablecoins combined; each chart row contains a Unix timestamp string and total circulating supply fields, including totalCirculatingUSD.

raw_payload_contract.primary_value_unit: USD-equivalent total circulating value of USD-pegged stablecoins as exposed by DefiLlama

coverage_contract.historical_row_selection: Use every schema-valid source row with metric_timestamp <= historical_cutoff_utc. Do not choose start/end dates by observed research performance.
coverage_contract.historical_start_rule: Earliest schema-valid source metric_timestamp returned by the frozen endpoint.
coverage_contract.historical_end_rule: Latest schema-valid source metric_timestamp not later than historical_cutoff_utc.
coverage_contract.dataset_registry_materialization_rule: Do not create a historical dataset slice until the first immutable full-history raw snapshot establishes truthful concrete start/end values and raw hash. The selection rule itself is frozen by this contract before retrieval.

pit_publication_semantics.forward_classification_rule: A raw snapshot captured after this data-contract merge may qualify observations as TEMPORALLY_UNSEEN only from their immutable first-seen retrieval time forward; later source revisions may not be backdated.
pit_publication_semantics.decision_inclusion_rule: At canonical decision timestamp T, an observation or revision is eligible only when available_at <= T.
pit_publication_semantics.revision_rule: Never overwrite a prior vintage. For an as-of decision T, use only revisions first retrieved at or before T; a later revision cannot alter an earlier decision view.
pit_publication_semantics.robustness_boundary: LAG_1D and LAG_3D are not alternatives under STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY-0001. They require a separately preregistered robustness-stage research ID.

raw_vintage_contract.repository_storage_rule: Large or recurring raw source payloads MUST NOT be committed to Git.
raw_vintage_contract.durable_storage_rule: Real forward-vintage collection requires durable external create-only/versioned storage. The repository filesystem implementation is a deterministic local/CI reference backend, not production durability authority.

exposure_and_registry_boundary.reason: Concrete historical slice start/end and raw identity do not exist until first immutable full-history capture; inventing them before retrieval would fabricate provenance.
